body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 5ee0131c1f30ac48013546914e29c98cdfa010cd -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a delta review of the merge of `upstream/main` at `1f15f98e7c68cb84e49b80d5d3c1676dcab524ac` (commit `5ee0131c1`). It is also a check of the full PR diff against the current rules.

**What looks good**

- The merge has one hand-resolved conflict, in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/stock_fit.rs`. I read it with `git show --remerge-diff`. The resolution keeps the main version of the file without changes. The PR diff against main does not change `stock_fit.rs`. All four stock-fit tests stay, and the helper `stock_pane_delete` still makes sure that the Stock page has exactly one Delete button.
- The merge changes no application code. The application changes in the PR are the same as on the reviewed head `da2c5c43`: the AccessKit `set_selected` in `gcode_view.rs`, the `Role::Pane` "Properties" wrapper in `pages.rs`, and `alt_text` in `tool_icons.rs`.
- The earlier findings stay resolved. The body has before and after screenshots, and both links load a 1280 × 720 PNG from the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch. The body has `Process change: yes`, and the PR does not change `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`.
- The `#[test]` count in `crates/ui` goes up: 1092 on main, 1109 on this head (this count includes one mention in `crates/ui/AGENTS.md`).
- No golden file and no snapshot PNG changes.

**Results merged with main** (locally, in `.claude/worktrees/review-2090` with its own `target/`; no GitHub runner)

The head already contains `upstream/main` at `1f15f98e7`. The trial merge said "Already up to date".

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | ok, 127 s, 0 failed |
| `camcraft-ui` lib | 963 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored |
| `boundary` | 3 passed |
| `boundary_picks` | 6 passed |
| `sinker_setup` | 2 passed |
| `tap_hand` | 3 passed |
| `theme_files` | 15 passed |
| `waterjet_tool` | 1 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | passed, no warnings |
| `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD` | passed |

**Requested before merge**

None.

**Notes (not blocking)**

1. This PR is still stacked on #1996, and #1996 is open. The diff of this PR includes the #1996 changes (`anchors.rs`, `page_layout.rs`, `docs/decisions/1953-ui-refit-test-plan.md`). Merge #1996 first, as the body says.
2. The PR is a draft. GitHub shows `mergeable` as `UNKNOWN` at the time of this review. The local trial merge has no conflict.
3. `stock_pane_delete` in `stock_fit.rs` (from main) finds the Delete button by the rectangle of the Properties dock leaf. This PR adds a `Role::Pane` "Properties" node. A follow-up can use that node in place of the rectangle, as the new rule in `crates/ui/AGENTS.md` recommends.
4. `alt_text(tex.name())` gives the texture name (`icon-...`) to screen readers. A follow-up can give a name that a person can read.
5. This PR does not change posted G-code, gouge or collision checks, stock simulation or geometry. The G-code change only sets the AccessKit selection state. This is not a safety-tier review, so I did not do mutations again. The 6 ignored tests stay ignored. I did not run pixel snapshots or test suites outside the UI gate map.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
